description: Explore which pixels buy margin most cheaply, as a companion to the rebased I039. On E030, add one extra 20 px epoch at the start (3x20+3x24+2x28+4x32, 12 epochs, LR triangle and Lookahead over total steps; same 20 px graph, no new shapes). Change nothing else. The 20 px epoch is the cheapest epoch (~0.43 s), and E031 showed that early-phase optimizer step count matters under Muon. So extra early steps may buy as much accuracy per second as the 32 px tail at roughly equal cost.
